notes.title: Scrap & Gold update - 1.2.5
notes.notes:
The 1.2.5 update is here with many new stuff and pathces!

[b]What was added[/b]

> Added new [b]Item Exchanger 3000[/b]
> Now with [b]Item Exchanger 3000[/b] you can exchange items with certain rarities to get a different item from the same rarity.
> Added Gift Codes that everyone can activate to get some cool rewards
> Added new [b]Green Hat[/b] that you can wear in Helmets > Green Hat
- Currently it doesn't have any bonuses, but in the future it will have cool bonuses that will help you at the beginning of the game!
> We now have our official [url=https://discord.gg/cV6pKcEFp6]Discord Server[/url].
> Added 7 new rarities for different items
- Fire rarity
- Nature rarity
- Water rarity
- Energy rarity
- Fishing rarity
- Attack rarity
- Event/Special rarity
> Added cool [b]Snow Effect[/b] that adds some atmosphere to the boringness.

[b]Game changes[/b]

> Fixed bug that caused mass spam in player-log file with zeroes that could eat up to 60 gb of space
> Fixed screen bug that would strech everything
> Changed Furnance interface.
- Now it is much better looking and easier to use!
> Fixed bug with legendary quests where you couldn't finish fishing/attack steps
> Guide Notebook was updated 
> Fixed bug with christmas event that ends after new year.

- Thanks everyone for your feedbacks. For any troubles & questions email me comdar16@gmail.com or make a post on Steam thread or Discord.

notes.title: Christmas Update - 1.2
notes.notes:
The 1.2 update is here with many new stuff and pathces!

[b]What was added[/b]

> Added new Christmas Shop that is avaible from 10 December till 10 January
- The items that can be bought are going to change every year
> Added new currency "Christmas Candy" that is used to buy stuff in the Christmas Shop
> Fixed the issue with furnance not working properly.
- If it still won't work as it should, please contact me on my email or on the steam forums
> Official steam deck support is now also here

[b]Game changes[/b]

> The craft recipe of certain fishing rod was again changed and so it is not hard anymore to obtain your first rod. 
> Some minor UI fixes/changes happened
> Some code optimization was also done

- Thanks everyone for your feedbacks. For any troubles & questions email me comdar16@gmail.com or make a post on Steam thread.

notes.title: Fishing Update - 1.1
notes.notes:
The 1.1 update is here with many new stuff and pathces!

[b]What was added[/b]

> Added a Guide Notebook where you learn something about specific feature or mechanic
> Added 2 new items - Poseidon Fragment, Ocean soul
> Added "Underwater Temple" tab in the workshop panel where you can craft Poseidon's armor and a powerfull Poseidon's Trident
> Added button for max upgrading
> Now there is a change for game skill to increase for upgrading resources
> Now you will see how many xp you got from attacks/fishing
> Added a new "Winner Of The Day" tab in the leaderboards where it will display the user who is #1 on leaderboard
> Added 5 new fishing rods
  - Flesh Rod
  - Barbed Rod
  - Plastic Rod
  - Holy Rod
  - Poseidon's Trident
> Added 3 new armor sets for Fishing
  - Wool set
  - Holy Set
  - Poseidon's Set

[b]Game changes[/b]

> Reduced timers for attacks/fishing
> Changed the UI style
> Changed Score and XP text color
> Increased smelting time from 5 seconds to 25 seconds
> Now crafting fishing equipment doesn not require Important map, but instead it requires scrap
> Increased chance and the amount of scrap that can be dropped by doing attacks at the beginning
> The Game Skill issue was fixed and now you can get Game Skill by upgrading resources/harvest,get more Game Skill by using "sell all" button in the shop

- Thanks everyone for your feedbacks. For any troubles & questions email me comdar16@gmail.com or make a post on Steam thread.
